map.按根字号把 rem 值反算为 px（px = rem × 根字号）: Convert a rem value back to px from the root font size (px = rem × root font size)
map.根字号可自定义，便于对应不同项目的 html font-size 设置: The root font size is customisable, which makes it easy to match the html font-size setting of a different project
map.结果保留 2 位小数，直接给出渲染后的实际像素值: The result keeps 2 decimal places and directly gives the actual pixel value after rendering
map.与设计稿对齐。: Align it with the design draft.
map.在「rem 值」输入设计稿或代码中的 rem 数值: Enter the rem value from the design draft or the code in the rem value field
map.填入当前项目的根字号（默认 16px）: Enter the root font size of the current project (16px by default)
map.读取结果区的 px 值: Read the px value in the result area
map.与设计稿标注或 DevTools 的 computed 值对照: Compare against the design draft annotations or the computed values in DevTools
map.若不一致，回到项目确认 html 的 font-size 是否被覆盖: If they do not match, go back to the project and check whether the html font-size has been overridden
map.调试布局时用 px 核对真实渲染尺寸最直观，rem 换算只是手段: When debugging a layout, checking the real rendered size in px is the most direct, and the rem conversion is only a means
